facts.claim: Udyr is a Freljordian spirit walker who communes with spirits and channels their energy into a primal fighting style.
Udyr has four basic abilities that swap between stances and can be recast for empowered spirit effects.
The League Wiki identifies Udyr's kit with animal-spirit stances including tiger, turtle, bear, and phoenix motifs.

signatureSignals: bear, tiger, turtle, and phoenix forms

facts.claim: Urgot was a Noxian headsman betrayed by the empire, chained in a Zaun prison mine, and later became a feared figure in Zaun's underworld.
Urgot's attacks and Purge trigger blasts of flame from the shotgun-like weapons mounted around his legs.
The League Wiki describes Urgot's leg-mounted weapons and Fear Beyond Death as a harpoon-based execution ability.
Varus is an ancient Darkin who escaped in the remade flesh of two Ionian hunters while carrying the bound essence of a cursed bow.
Varus's kit centers on Piercing Arrow, Blighted Quiver, Hail of Arrows, and Chain of Corruption.
The League Wiki records Varus as a unique hybrid whose body contains the separate consciousnesses of Varus, Valmar, and Kai, with corruption and hemomancy tied to his Darkin nature.
Vayne is a Demacian monster hunter who carries a wrist-mounted crossbow and hunts the evil-doer who destroyed her family.

source.title: Vayne, the Night Hunter | League of Legends

facts.claim: Vayne's signature abilities include Tumble, Silver Bolts, Condemn, and Final Hour with invisibility during Tumble.

source.title: Vayne, the Night Hunter | League of Legends

facts.claim: The League Wiki describes Silver Bolts as a rare-metal third-hit effect and Night Hunter as movement toward nearby enemy champions.
Veigar is a Bandle City yordle who embraced forbidden dark sorcery and calls himself a master of evil.
Veigar permanently gains ability power from spells hitting champions or takedowns, making growth a defining part of his passive.
The League Wiki lists Dark Matter, Event Horizon, and Primordial Burst as Veigar's defining dark-magic tools, including a cage-like stun field and meteor-like burst.
Vel'Koz is the Eye of the Void, an intelligent Void being whose abilities apply Organic Deconstruction to enemies.
Vel'Koz's kit includes Plasma Fission, Void Rift, Tectonic Disruption, and Life Form Disintegration Ray.
The League Wiki describes Vel'Koz as a Void creature with tentacular anatomy and a strong research, dissection, and disintegration theme.
Vex is a gloomy yordle from the Shadow Isles who travels with a powerful living Shadow companion.
Vex's Doom 'n Gloom passive empowers an ability to fear enemies and responds to nearby enemy dashes with marks.
The League Wiki describes Shadow Surge as Vex's shadow projectile that marks a champion and lets her dash to the marked target.

unresolved: Unicode has no specific icon for Vex's Shadow companion or yordle identity.

facts.claim: Vi is the Piltover Enforcer, a Zaun-born fighter who uses massive hextech gauntlets to punch through obstacles and suspects.
Vi charges Vault Breaker and uses Cease and Desist to lock onto and knock up a target while her attacks build Denting Blows.
The League Wiki highlights Vi's charged dash, armor-breaking three-hit passive, and targeted airborne ultimate as core gameplay signatures.
Viego is the Ruined King whose obsession with restoring his dead queen Isolde unleashed the Ruination and Black Mist.
Viego can possess slain champions, temporarily taking their form and basic abilities before casting Heartbreaker.

source.title: Viego - Abilities Rundown | League of Legends

facts.claim: The League Wiki describes Sovereign's Domination as consuming Mist Wraiths to become untargetable and gain possession, while the Ruined King story centers the Black Mist and Isolde.

emojiCandidates.meaning: obsession with Isolde and lost love

facts.claim: Viktor has embraced a biomechanical Glorious Evolution and seeks to spread the revelation of the Hexcore.
Viktor collects Hex Fragments from kills to permanently augment his basic abilities and ultimately his Arcane Storm.
The League Wiki lists Gravity Field, Hextech Ray, and Arcane Storm as Viktor's core control, laser, and storm abilities.
Vladimir is a Noxian hemomancer who can control blood and extend his life through supernatural power.
Vladimir's kit drains blood, charges Tides of Blood, and spreads Hemoplague while using health as a resource.
The League Wiki identifies Sanguine Pool as Vladimir sinking into a blood pool, becoming untargetable while slowing and damaging nearby enemies.

unresolved: There is no literal blood-pool Unicode glyph, so the pool clue is represented by untargetability and water imagery.

facts.claim: Volibear is a Freljordian demigod whose identity is tied to thunder, storms, and the savage Ursine.
Volibear's attacks and abilities build attack speed and eventually deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.
The League Wiki's Relentless Storm lore describes Volibear casting off armor to fight with tooth, claw, and thunder.

source.title: The Relentless Storm - League of Legends Wiki

facts.claim: Warwick is an engineered beast hunting Zaun's gray alleys, with chemtech machinery and an intense attraction to the scent of blood.
Warwick heals from his attacks while low on health and senses weakened enemies through Blood Hunt, gaining movement and attack speed toward them.
The League Wiki highlights Warwick's bite, low-health healing, blood tracking, and asymmetrical chemtech machinery as defining features.
Wukong is the Monkey King, a Vastaya trained in Wuju who fights with an enchanted staff.
Wukong's kit includes Warrior Trickster, which turns him invisible and leaves a clone, and Cyclone, which spins his staff and knocks enemies up.
The League Wiki's Monkey King story connects Wukong to Master Yi, Wuju training, a decoy, and an enchanted staff.

source.title: The Monkey King - League of Legends Wiki

facts.claim: Xayah is a Lhotlan Vastaya rebel who fights to reclaim her people and their ancient magic.
Xayah's abilities create and recall feathers, and Featherstorm lets her leap into the air while firing a cone of feathers.
The League Wiki describes Clean Cuts, Bladecaller, Featherstorm, and Xayah's paired recall with Rakan as her main gameplay and relationship signatures.

emojiCandidates.meaning: feathers created and recalled by her kit

facts.claim: Xerath is an Ascended Magus of ancient Shurima, made of arcane energy trapped in the broken shards of a magical sarcophagus.
Xerath's kit is built around long-range arcane artillery including Arcanopulse, Eye of Destruction, Shocking Orb, and Rite of the Arcane.
The League Wiki's lore presents Xerath as a betrayed Shuriman slave whose ascension destroyed the empire and left him a being of arcane energy.
Xin Zhao is a Demacian loyalist and former Noxian arena fighter who wields a favored three-talon spear.
Xin Zhao's kit includes Three Talon Strike and Crescent Guard, which creates a protective circle and excludes non-challenged enemies.
The League Wiki identifies Xin Zhao's third-hit heal, spear attacks, Demacian service, and Crescent Guard zone as his core gameplay identity.

source.title: Xin Zhao | League of Legends Wiki

facts.claim: Yasuo is an Ionian swordsman forced to flee after being blamed for a fatal mistake and is commonly framed as a wandering samurai.
Yasuo's kit centers on Steel Tempest, Wind Wall, Sweeping Blade, and Last Breath.
The League Wiki identifies Yasuo's wind technique, katana skill, and Wind Wall as key distinctions from ordinary sword fighters.
Yone was Yasuo's half-brother, died by Yasuo's hand, returned from the spirit realm, and wears the mask of a defeated azakana.
Yone uses two blades and has Spirit Cleave, Soul Unbound, and Fate Sealed in his kit.

source.title: Yone - Abilities Rundown | League of Legends

facts.claim: The League Wiki describes Yone's astral projection, spirit blade, demonic mask, and two-katana fighting style.
Yorick is the last survivor of a religious order on the Shadow Isles and is cursed and blessed with power over the dead.
Yorick can summon Mist Walkers and the Maiden of the Mist, while Last Rites, Dark Procession, and Mourning Mist shape his graveyard gameplay.
The League Wiki presents Yorick's Cursed Horde, Mist Walkers, Maiden, and Shadow Isles mist as his defining summon-and-push identity.

unresolved: Unicode lacks a shovel glyph with consistent support, so a pickaxe is used as the nearest grave-tool symbol.

facts.claim: Yunara is an Ionia-devoted warrior who spent centuries in the spirit realm honing her skills with the legendary Aion Er'na relic.
Yunara's kit includes a spinning prayer bead and changes that attack into a damaging slowing laser while she is in her Transcendent State.
The League Wiki catalogs Yunara's Ionia, spirit, prayer-bead, and ability-icon references, while community discussion describes her Unleash and transcendence mechanics.

source.title: Yunara Gameplay and Abilities Discussion | Reddit

facts.claim: The League Wiki's champion-data entry catalogs Yunara's prayer-bead, Kanmei's Steps, and Transcend One's Self abilities.

source.title: Template:Data Yunara | League of Legends Wiki

signatureSignals: Aion Er'na relic and prayer beads

emojiCandidates.meaning: spinning prayer bead and relic tradition
centuries of spiritual devotion and training

unresolved: Yunara is recent and has limited established community emoji conventions; the relic and prayer-bead clues need blind testing with current players.

facts.claim: Yuumi is the Magical Cat, a Bandle City companion who travels with a sentient book while searching for her missing master.
Yuumi's kit includes You and Me!, which attaches her to an ally, Prowling Projectile, Zoomies, and Final Chapter.
The League Wiki highlights Yuumi's attachment, Best Friend relationship, magical book, and ally-focused healing as her distinguishing identity.

emojiCandidates.meaning: sentient book and search for her master

facts.claim: Zaahen is a Darkin champion whose attacks and abilities against champions grant Determination stacks and bonus attack damage.
Zaahen's official champion profile lists The Darkin Glaive, Dreaded Return, Aureate Rush, and Grim Deliverance among his signature abilities.
In a Riot team AMA, the developers said Zaahen intentionally adopts aspects and ability references of Xin Zhao, creating a Darkin contrast to the Demacian spear fighter.

source.title: We're the team behind League's newest champion, Zaahen, Ask Us Anything! | Reddit

facts.claim: Leaguepedia documents Zaahen's Determination passive, The Darkin Glaive, and Dreaded Return as core parts of his kit.

source.title: Zaahen | League of Legends Esports Wiki

unresolved: Zaahen is recent and the current Unicode set has no glaive or Determination symbol; the proposed set may need player validation to separate him from Aatrox and Xin Zhao.

facts.claim: Zac formed from a toxic spill through a chemtech seam and grew from primordial ooze into a thinking being living in Zaun's pipes.
Zac sheds chunks of himself after hitting enemies and splits into four bloblets on fatal damage that can recombine to revive him.
The League Wiki describes Zac's chunks, four bloblet Cell Division, Elastic Slingshot, and Let's Bounce as his defining goo and movement mechanics.
Zed is the Master of Shadows, an Ionian ninja who embraced forbidden shadow techniques.
Zed's kit creates Living Shadows, throws Razor Shurikens, uses Shadow Slash, and applies Death Mark.
The League Wiki connects Zed's gameplay to energy, shadow clones, shuriken projectiles, and the assassin's marked return after Death Mark.
Zeri is the Spark of Zaun, a magic-born marksman whose electrical power is inseparable from her identity and home.
Zeri's gameplay uses Burst Fire as her basic attack, Spark Surge to move through terrain, and Lightning Crash to build a charged electric fight state.
Riot's Champion Insights describes Zeri's concept as beginning with a gun and highlights rollerblades as a distinctive movement choice; the League Wiki documents her electric kit.

source.title: Champion Insights: Zeri | League of Legends

facts.claim: The League Wiki documents Zeri's Spark Surge terrain dash and Lightning Crash overcharge and electric-chain mechanics.

source.title: Zeri (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki

emojiCandidates.meaning: Spark of Zaun and electrical magic

facts.claim: Ziggs is a Zaun-based yordle explosives expert who loves big bombs and befriended Jinx after leaving a predictable life in Piltover.
Ziggs uses Bouncing Bomb, Satchel Charge, Hexplosive Minefield, and Mega Inferno Bomb, with Satchel Charge also able to destroy vulnerable turrets.
The League Wiki details Ziggs's bouncing bombs, proximity mines, self-knockback Satchel, and turret-execution mechanic.
Zilean is the Chronokeeper, an ancient time mage who seeks to undo the destruction of Icathia.
Zilean throws Time Bombs, can Rewind his abilities, accelerates or slows with Time Warp, and saves an ally with Chronoshift.
The League Wiki documents Zilean's clock-and-bomb kit, cooldown reduction, speed manipulation, and resurrection effect.
Zoe is the Aspect of Twilight, a cosmic messenger of Targon whose mischief and imagination can reshape reality.
Zoe can pick up remnants of enemy summoner spells and active items, uses Sleepy Trouble Bubble, and briefly portals with Portal Jump.
The League Wiki describes Zoe's spell theft, portal jump, sleep bubble, and cosmic messenger identity as her distinctive mechanics and lore.

emojiCandidates.meaning: Aspect of Twilight and cosmic messenger

facts.claim: Zyra is Rise of the Thorns, a predatory plant-human creature from Ixtal whose body and powers are made of plant life.
Zyra's kit grows Thorn Spitters from seeds, sends Grasping Roots, and summons a Stranglethorns thicket that knocks enemies up.
The League Wiki describes Zyra as a unique human-plant hybrid that creates vines, thorn flowers, and infectious spores.
